# ICU - Ian Cero's utils

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of **ICU** is to serve as a catch all package for frequently used utility functions that generally don't have a home in other packages or which are convenient to re-export all in one place.

## Installation

You can install the development version of **ICU** from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("iancero/icu")
```
